name: Imgflip
tagline: Free meme caption API for popular templates with optional Premium GIF/AI features.
description: Imgflip's RESTful JSON API lists popular meme templates and captions them into shareable images. Free tier supports get_memes and caption_image (with watermark); Premium ($9.99/mo) unlocks GIF captioning, full meme search, AI generation, and watermark removal. Auth uses Imgflip username/password form fields—no API key header.

auth.details: Imgflip account username and password sent as form fields (username, password) on caption endpoints; get_memes needs no auth. Self-serve signup at imgflip.com/signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free: get_memes + caption_image unlimited (fair use); watermarked output. Premium $9.99/mo includes monthly Premium request allotments then per-request fees for GIF/search/AI/no-watermark.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium API base $9.99/month plus included Premium requests; overage per-request pricing for advanced endpoints (details on docs).

rate_limits: No hard published numeric limit; docs state requests may be rate-limited if you make a lot; abusive use may be throttled/blocked.
use_cases: list popular meme templates with IDs and image URLs
caption a meme template with top and bottom text
generate a shareable meme image URL for a chat bot reply
build a meme picker UI from the top 100 templates
caption a custom uploaded image as a meme (with credentials)
